safeguards.name: canonical preregistration generation

safeguards.name: full archive binding
safeguards.rationale: The invalid-collection archives bind the canonical hash of the complete preregistration record, preserving provenance beyond the protocol subsection.

safeguards.name: drift regression coverage
safeguards.rationale: The new v2-v5 archive-binding assertion complements existing generator-to-committed-record checks.

safeguards.name: non-overwriting generators
safeguards.rationale: The existing generators continue to refuse direct overwrites; regeneration was first written to verified temporary outputs.

design_boundary.rationale: Versioned generators remain the canonical owners of preregistration bytes; JSON records remain derived artifacts.

extension_decision.rationale: The repair restores existing versioned experiment contracts without creating an extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: Each experiment's versioned generator is authoritative for its preregistration, while each archive records the resulting immutable record identity.

error_model.rationale: Existing tests continue to fail closed when a frozen input, derived hash, or archive binding drifts.

contract_evolution.rationale: The frozen policy snapshot filename changed from SKILL.md to frozen-policy.md, and every path- and hash-derived record was synchronized.

operational_budget.rationale: The repair is deterministic JSON regeneration and test coverage with no application runtime budget change.

threat_boundary.rationale: Hash-bound inputs and full archive bindings prevent a path rename or partial record substitution from silently changing experiment provenance.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: Generators, path consumers, derived records, archival metadata, tests, independent review, and evidence were updated as one coherent repair.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployed runtime or rollout configuration is changed; reverting the scoped repair restores the prior package state.

data_migration.rationale: No application schema or persisted user data is migrated.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No configuration, credential, or secret boundary changed.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency manifest, lockfile, package source, or supply-chain control changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The archive-binding test and hash-bound evidence record document the required regeneration behavior for future frozen-policy changes.

reproducibility.rationale: The evidence captures deterministic generation, full-suite output, compilation, package validation, patch formatting, Git revision, timestamps, and content hashes.
